hook.name: Psyche
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook permanently bound to a single pool containing the USEPOD ERC-20 token. Applies a variable swap surcharge (5–50 bps) via BeforeSwapDelta in beforeSwap, scaled by each swapper's contribution coefficient (derived from token tenure, balance weight, and swap witness count), routing the surcharge differential back to liquidity providers.
